_comment: Corrections to harvested rows where Wikidata itself is wrong. Applied by scripts/dedupe-places.mjs on every run (after the harvest), so the nightly harvest cannot put the mistake back. A value of null removes that field. Each fix: the fields to set (name, lat, lon, startYear, endYear, placeNote, dateNote), why, and the source checked. A moved pin is also listed in wikidata-coord-exceptions.json so the 25 km lint knows it is deliberate.

q603549.placeNote: Wikidata places this battle in southern Iraq (31.58, 44.50), about 450 km from Nahavand. It was fought at Nahavand, near Hamadan in Iran; the pin is on the town.

q47465940.name: Operation Olive Branch (Afrin)
q47465940.why: Wrong year: the Turkish operation in Afrin ran 20 January – 24 March 2018

q111383245.why: Wrong year: the battle ran 10 October 2023 – 17 February 2024

q1355254.placeNote: Wikidata places this battle in Cilicia (37.89, 36.00), about 740 km from Poimanenon. It was fought near Poimanenon, south of the Sea of Marmara (near modern Manyas); the pin uses Pleiades' precise position for the town.

q11812902.why: Wrong year (2020): Serengeti National Park was established in 1951

q107370.dateNote: Founded as Iceland's first national park in 1930, on the 1,000th anniversary of the Althing, the parliament that met here from 930. A World Heritage Site since 2004.
q107370.why: Wrong year (2004 is its World Heritage listing): the national park dates from 1930

q214944.dateNote: Built from about 9500 BCE, in the Pre-Pottery Neolithic. Wikidata gives only the millennium.
q214944.why: Wikidata's millennium-precision date read as -9999; matches the curated entry (c. 9500 BCE)

q39671.dateNote: Built in stages: the first ditch and bank c. 3000 BCE, the great sarsen circle c. 2500 BCE, work continuing until about 1600 BCE.
q39671.why: Wikidata date (-1848) is neither the start nor the main building phase

q134140.dateNote: Carved for Ramesses II from about 1264 BCE, finished about 1244 BCE. Moved 65 m uphill in 1964–68 to escape Lake Nasser.
q134140.why: Wrong year (-1274 is the Battle of Kadesh it celebrates): begun c. 1264 BCE

q752091.dateNote: Built about 1250 under King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.

q5684.why: End year 1599 CE is meaningless (no such event); Babylon declined after the Seleucid era and the ruin still stands. Removed.
